output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial supply is set in the constructor, minted to the owner, and can be exploited to overflow the balanceOf mapping, causing a denial of service.
The transfer function allows the owner to transfer tokens to any address, including a compromised exchange, causing token devaluation.
The transferFrom function allows spender to transfer tokens from owner to any address, causing token devaluation.
The approve function has a typo in the function name, allowing attackers to exploit it during the initial token distribution, causing token devaluation.
The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing attackers to mint tokens to any address, causing a denial of service.
